title: Python for Data Science
wikitext:
== Course Overview ==
'''Python for Data Science''' is a beginner-friendly course teaching Python programming fundamentals and data science applications.

== Instructor ==
[[Dr. Sarah Johnson]]

== Course Details ==
| Level | Beginner |
| Duration | 12 hours |
| Lessons | 42 |
| Price | $89 |
| Rating | 4.8/5 (2,341 reviews)

== What You'll Learn ==
* Python syntax and data structures
* Data manipulation with pandas
* Data visualization with matplotlib
* Introduction to machine learning

== Prerequisites ==
No prior programming experience required.
